question: Did you open and read every file in migrations/? Answer yes or no, then say which files you did not read.
answer:
Yes. I printed the full contents of all 40 files (`0001_init.py` through `0040_vacuum_marker.py`) with one `cat` loop over `migrations/*.py`, and read through them.

There are no files I skipped. One caveat: I listed the directory with plain `ls`, which hides dotfiles, and my loop only matched `*.py`. If there are hidden or non-Python files in `migrations/`, I haven't looked at them. `ls` showed exactly 40 entries, all `.py`, so I don't expect any. Running `ls -a migrations` would settle it.
